title: AI-Powered Personalized Learning for Neurodivergent Students
summary: Addis Ababa Science and Technology University proposes an adaptive AI learning assistant for neurodivergent students; no source reports that students used it.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Addis Ababa Science and Technology University in Ethiopia proposes a real-time adaptive learning assistant for neurodivergent students. The team plans a pilot of a special-education prototype that would adapt teaching to the cognitive and emotional needs of students. Its account in an International Telecommunication Union report states that the project had no formal institutional or organizational partners as of June 2025. No source reports effects on learning or well-being. No report after June 2025 describes a pilot or a result.
purpose: Tailor learning pace and support to neurodivergent students' needs.
system: AI personalized-learning system for neurodivergent students
developer: Addis Ababa Science and Technology University

data.answer:
A planned special-education pilot aims to adapt teaching to students' cognitive and emotional needs. Learning and well-being effects are not yet reported.

Adapting content to inferred cognitive or emotional needs does not establish that the inferences are accurate or beneficial. Learning, well-being, accessibility, and unequal error effects have not been measured in the retained account.

The project account does not separately evaluate AI’s contribution to the benefit.
